people.appearance: Short dark-haired player in white, blue number 10, black undersleeves and gloves, light bright boots.
White number 6, dark head covering, black undersleeves, white socks.
Taller light-haired opponent in red number 15, black shorts and socks.
Red number 7, black shorts and socks; retreats immediately ahead of white number 10 and contests him beside the goalkeeper.
Red number 16, dark hair or dark head covering, black shorts and socks, pale boots; chases the white attacker and arrives centrally.
Goalkeeper in blue-purple kit, dark leggings, gloves and pale boots; number 1 visible in the aftermath.
Dark-haired red defender, black shorts and socks, following behind number 16 and subsequently inside the goalmouth; number not established.
White number 4 with blue head covering and black gloves; follows the attack without making the finish.

outcome_evidence.fact: White number 10 reaches into a crowded contest containing two red players and another white player.
The ball emerges toward white number 6, while number 10 remains to the left.

actions.details: Number 10 participates in the opening contest, then moves left into space. The overlapping legs do not establish which player's touch sends the ball out toward number 6; this is not credited as a pass by number 10.

outcome_evidence.fact: Number 6 has the ball beside his boot outside the opening crowd.
Number 6 retains the ball after turning away from a close red challenger.

actions.details: Collects the loose ball, takes short controlling touches and shields it through a red player's challenge before opening his body to play left.

contact_evidence.fact: Number 6 has the ball immediately beside his foot with the challenger behind him.
Number 6 extends his kicking leg leftward and the ball has departed along the ground to the left.

outcome_evidence.fact: The released ball travels left toward number 10, with red number 15 stepping across its route.
The ball reaches number 10 on the left of red number 15.
Number 10 has turned with the ball and begins advancing left.
Number 10 is falling beside the goal after his close-range release; the same ball continues across the goalmouth.
The tracked active ball is visibly within the goal, behind the goalmouth players.

actions.details: Ground pass to number 10, who carries through to the finish without a teammate's intervening pass. Red number 15 steps at the passing lane; a brush is possible, but the sequence does not show him establishing controlled possession or making a separate pass. The finishing contact is bracketed in a5 rather than assigned an invented exact frame.

outcome_evidence.fact: Number 10 advances with the ball in front of him while a red opponent presses from behind.
Number 10 chases his forward touch toward goal, with red number 7 retreating ahead and another defender pursuing.
Number 10 reaches the ball alongside red number 7 immediately in front of the goalkeeper.

actions.details: Receives on the left, turns, dribbles past the first pressure and runs after a longer forward touch. Red number 7 gets between him and the goalkeeper, but no distinct controlled opponent possession or deliberate intervening pass is established. Number 10 continues into the close-range contest.

contact_evidence.fact: Number 10 is alongside red number 7 over the ball, beginning the low reaching movement while the goalkeeper spreads in front.
Number 10 has extended a leg and is falling left; the ball has emerged from the contest and is moving right past the goalkeeper.

outcome_evidence.fact: The active ball is clear of the original contest and rolling rightward beside the goalkeeper.
The ball continues toward the goal-line area as red number 16 and the defender behind him converge.
The rear red defender makes a sweeping leg movement, but number 16 obscures the ball and any contact.
The ball reappears inside the goal area beyond the converging defenders.
The same ball is airborne within the netted goal, behind the goalkeeper and defenders.
The ball remains inside the goal and the goalkeeper turns to follow it.

actions.details: Number 10 makes the close-range reaching finish while challenged by red number 7, then falls. His movement and the ball's departure support him as the initial shooter, although the exact boot-ball instant is hidden. The goalkeeper's spread is not treated as a save: no stopping or reversal of the ball is established. A later defender attempts a clearance with the ball briefly hidden behind number 16. The active ball subsequently appears inside the goal, establishing the goal outcome, but the images do not isolate a goalkeeper brush, the later defender's contact, or whether the whole ball had crossed before that attempt. Number 10 later rises and returns toward his teammates.

outcome_evidence.fact: The defender behind red number 16 swings a leg across the goalmouth.
The active ball is inside the goal despite the attempted intervention.

actions.details: Attempted goal-line clearance, not an established controlled recovery or pass. The sweeping movement is visible, but number 16 masks the potential contact. The intervention does not keep the ball out.
